name: Cyrus Javadi

bio.statement: Javadi's pamphlet statement lists his occupation as dentist and State Representative.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 5), p. 41

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists prior governmental experience as commissioner of the Port of Tillamook Bay and dental director of Tillamook County Community Health Centers.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Commissioner, Port of Tillamook Bay; Dental Director, Tillamook County Community Health Centers

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 5), p. 41

bio.statement: His official legislature page identifies him as Representative Cyrus Javadi, Democrat, District 32.

positions.statement: Javadi's pamphlet statement says he fought to keep local hospitals and clinics open when cuts threatened rural hospitals.
positions.excerpt: When cuts threatened rural hospitals like Columbia Memorial and Providence Seaside, Cyrus fought to keep local hospitals and clinics open.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 5), p. 41

positions.statement: His statement says he expanded tax cuts for the middle class, took on utility companies to lower rates, and battled drug makers to cap insulin costs.
positions.excerpt: He expanded tax cuts for the middle-class, took on utility companies to lower rates, and battled pharmaceutical companies to cap insulin costs and require price transparency.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 5), p. 41

positions.statement: His statement says he passed a bill helping local families and first-time homebuyers by standing up to corporations that buy single-family homes.
positions.excerpt: Cyrus passed a bill helping local families and first-time homebuyers have a fair shot at buying a home by standing up to corporations who snatch up single family homes.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 5), p. 41

positions.statement: His statement says he will protect every woman's right to birth control and abortion without political interference.
positions.excerpt: Cyrus will protect every woman's fundamental right to birth control and abortion, without political interference.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet, General Election 2026 (Book 5), p. 41
